title: Accept a Higher Power
coreMove: Stillness grows when you do your duty, ask what belongs to something larger than ego, and release the fantasy that your will must secure the whole world.

exampleSpecs.audience: a counter clerk correcting an error under pressure
exampleSpecs.stakes: A hidden log error could send the wrong tool back into circulation.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: An interrupted routine becomes a deliberate restart.

exampleSpecs.audience: a ticket clerk learning to feel the wider system
exampleSpecs.stakes: One private favor can ripple through crews, riders, and the schedule.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A small booth detail reveals interdependence without a live fork.

exampleSpecs.audience: a clerk reviewing a policy failure after closing
exampleSpecs.stakes: A kind exception has damaged trust in the return log.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Evidence after the event shows where control replaced duty.

exampleSpecs.audience: a superintendent working alone after hours
exampleSpecs.stakes: Guessing at an electrical label could make the building less safe.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The protagonist catches his own control fantasy before the fix.

exampleSpecs.audience: a coach carrying too much into one session
exampleSpecs.stakes: A crowded practice can turn care into possession.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A written note makes one cut and names the duty left.

exampleSpecs.audience: lab staff responding to a temperature alarm
exampleSpecs.stakes: Delay could threaten cold storage and the integrity of the log.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two people show opposite relations to help and control.
